Select canonical_smiles, substrate_compound_name, parent_compound_name, met_conversion, pathway_key, organism, enzyme_name. Source metabolism, compound_structures, molecule_dictionary, docs. Join metabolism to compound_structures on substrate_record_id = record_id, metabolism to molecule_dictionary on drug_record_id = molregno, metabolism to docs on drug_record_id = doc_id. Filter enzyme_name equals 'CYP2B6'. Sort by canonical_smiles, substrate_compound_name, parent_compound_name, met_conversion, pathway_key, organism, enzyme_name. Limit 200.
